comments: de3a5e57: ;Call DE (subroutine to set up variables) and jump to BEGIN
08ae736c: ;Set variables for FileMan call. DP=file #, DIC=global root, allow LAYGO into ^VAS(393,"DA",0)
1049c5a4: ;If existing 0 node, set DE(1) = MESSAGE field
2ae33671: ;If existing MSG node, set DE(2) = 1st piece of MSG node
ea8c94ef: ;Clean up values
5a24481f: ;Write prompt
e47ee11c: ;Terminate W subroutine
714526f0: ;Call W to write prompt, then if response is long, wrap to new line
a391e549: ;If the response is >19 chars, and this is not a wordprocessing field, and the directionality isn't explicitly inherited, go to RW^DIR2 for word-wrapping
0a2909ed: ;Add "// " prefix, if response exists. If this is not a wordprocessing field, and DIR is inheriting, AND DIR value exists, display "(No Editing)"
d7d6aaac: ;Get response, if timeout, set DTOUT & X=^. Beep on timeout
a0e389f7: ;Terminate TR subroutine
b3786338: Initialize a counter DQ to 1
e902de2f: Transfer control based on the value of DQ
d1e6eee5: If DE(DQ) exists, go to label PR, otherwise execute W and TR
7e722885: If X is empty, branch based on conditions involving DV, D
f663de3f: If X starts with '?', go to QS. If X contains '^', execute D and jump to ^DIE17
b5e7304f: If X is '@', execute D and jump to Z^DIE2
e592f092: If X is a space, DV contains 'd' but not 'P', and ^DISV(DUZ,"DIE",DLB) exists, set X to its value. If DV doesn't contain 'D' or 'S', write '  ' followed by X

17b71ec8: Branch to M^DIE17 if DV is true, ^DIE3 if DV contains 'V', or P if DV doesn't contain 'S'. If ^DD(DP,DIFLD,12.1) exists, execute it. Set % to part of DU delimited by X, and Y to X. If % is non-empty and DIC("S") exists, execute DIC("S"). If no DB(DQ) exists, write '  ' followed by %. Go to V

641e3ab2: Loop through parts of DU delimited by ';'. For each part Y, find position DG of ':'_X in Y. If Y is empty, go to X. Set YS to Y and Y to part before ':'. If DG is non-zero and DIC("S") exists, execute DIC("S"). If DG is non-zero, quit the loop
1295abac: If no DB(DQ) exists, write substring of YS from position DG to the end. Set X to part of YS before ':'
30df5ee2: If the call to File Manager returned an error, quit.
19bcaa4b: If the input variable is numeric, go to the validator. If the input is longer than 24 characters after the decimal point, reject it.
29d67077: If the comma piece is defined and the input contains a decimal point and the DD field is not computed, remove leading and trailing zeroes from the input decimal.
7c5a5cce: Execute the DIMVSP (Input Variable Processing) code for the data dictionary field.
4ecca55d: If the input was valid, update the global for the current field, and if the DD field is a date, update the audit trail global.
d8421d09: If an error occurred, branch to the code that will display the error message.
740f1236: Set the error code to indicate a bad input value.
8d764559: Quit out of this routine. Save DZ, call DIE0 DRIVER and QQ^DIE, then go to the tag B.
4f18495e: Set current field number D, and save field parameters to DQ array.

4d2dc565: If data is undefined for this current field, do overflow logic and then either read in data if echo is not kill, call ask access logic, or kill input variable X if it is a kill fields. Otherwise, set Y=X to begin input transform.
1acd4f7d: Save a few things and execute code specific to this x-ref.  Then return.
594e34ad: If pointer to file with POINTER, P global, get .01 value, DISPLAY value, and pointer screening logic value.
cfbdbf71: If pointer to file with POINTED VALUE, get .01 value, DISPLAY value, and pointer screening logic.
f2ab1604: Execute COMPUTED FIELD code (if any). If SET LOGIC, set Y from code.
e9e01222: If X is null, set X=EXISTING VALUE. If DV is COMPUTED-CODE and this is not the 2nd time thru, re-INDEX (A). If DV is computed-field and this is the 2nd time thru, QUIT (N).
e4b34679: If NOT an INPUT TRANSFORM, skip to read.
9be1c406: Execute INPUT TRANSFORM. If successful, return to PR to reset DG, etc.
7ba6030e: QUIT.
58fa0d19: Set variable names for executable help and field order.
7bf6ee83: Execute EXECUTABLE HELP code.
57a311eb: Set up pointer screening logic.
8a422401: Set the initial value of X to DGJTST.
88a656e8: Set Y=X.
4874c916: If X is null, go compute external value (N). Else store it, execute INPUT TRANSFORM (E) if it exists, and go to A if data is ok.
0d529d67: If X is not null, go to Z to edit data. Otherwise, read in data.
fa545827: Quit if the execution reaches this label.
084afc0e: Initialize values for variables used in the routine.
d15695d8: Go to the label RE.
cb045407: Remove the variable X if its length is greater than 200 or less than 3 characters.
197fc65b: Remove the variable X if it exists and contains non-alphanumeric characters.
1c7d9569: Quit the current execution.
1b5105ad: Transfer execution to the label 0^DIE17.
